settlement_source: United States Congress (SENATEPARTY terms; congress.gov). Accelerated path: >=4 of 8 Designated Media Sources (NYT, AP, DDHQ, CNN, Fox, NBC, CBS, ABC) call winner with no contradiction.
settlement_variable: Party of the first candidate who presents a certificate of election and is sworn in to the Louisiana Senate seat for the term beginning 2027 (replacement's party if vacancy before seating; election-day party if candidate switches before swearing-in)
tie_handling: No explicit tie clause: unknown. Louisiana runoff/primary mechanics not addressed in terms (unknown).
trading_close_vs_settlement: Nominal close_time 2027-11-03 15:00Z. Expiration = sooner of first 10:00 AM ET after swearing-in or one year after the popular vote; accelerated resolution on media consensus (can_close_early=1). Settlement no later than day after expiration unless under review; timer 1800s.
early_close_or_void_clauses: Accelerated determination via >=4/8 media sources, none contradicting
Exchange may replace a Designated Media Source at sole discretion
Market Outcome Review (Rule 6.3(c)) at sole discretion
Vacancy before seating: replacement's party governs
title_vs_rules_divergences: Title 'win the Senate race' (election winner) vs rules: party of the person SWORN IN; differs on death/resignation/vacancy before seating
yes_sub_title names a candidate (Julia Letlow / Jamie Davis) but rules settle on party only
Party switch between election and swearing-in: resolves on election-day party
Settlement is at swearing-in (Jan 2027) or accelerated media call, not election day itself
toxicity_flags: Election-night vote-count observers/decision-desk staff have info edge (explicitly prohibited groups)
Accelerated resolution can close market abruptly on media call
Very long-dated (close 2027-11-03) capital lock if no early call
Sole-discretion review and media-source replacement clause
notes: R ~0.84-0.85, D ~0.15-0.16. Outcome not publicly observable until the general election results; only SENATEPARTY terms read, full market rules page not fetched.
